articles.description: Saving Grace Humane Society is offering $50 kitten adoptions through July 3. Each kitten goes home spayed or neutered, microchipped and current on age-appropriate vaccines and flea treatments.
articles.title: Saving Grace Humane Society Offering $50 Kitten Adoptions Through July 3

articles.description: A Roseburg man was arrested after police said TikTok videos showed him riding a green Kawasaki Ninja recklessly on public roads, including at speeds of up to 152 mph.
articles.title: Roseburg Man Arrested After Police Say TikTok Videos Showed Reckless Motorcycle Riding

articles.author: Joseph Ziegler
articles.description: Firefighters from multiple agencies stopped a grass fire near Dairy Loop Road in Roseburg on Tuesday afternoon, holding it to 2.2 acres. DFPA said hay bales and equipment may continue producing visible smoke, but no evacuations are in place.
articles.title: Grass Fire Near Dairy Loop Road Held To 2.2 Acres

articles.author: Joseph Ziegler
articles.description: Roseburg police reported five incidents in the June 23 log, including disorderly conduct, warrant arrests, theft, trespass and a court-order violation. Date and time entries are listed as provided by Roseburg Police.
articles.title: Police Log: June 22, 2026

articles.author: Joseph Ziegler
articles.description: DFPA will conduct live-fire training this week in Roseburg, Myrtle Creek and Elkton. Residents may see smoke between about 11 a.m. and 2 p.m. as firefighters, camera detection staff and dispatch operators train in controlled conditions.
articles.title: DFPA Live-Fire Training May Bring Visible Smoke To Parts Of Douglas County This Week

articles.description: Roseburg Public Library will host Dragon Theater Puppets for “Johnny Appleseed: Planting the Seeds of Adventure” at 1 p.m. Tuesday, June 30. The free show is geared toward children from pre-K through fifth grade and their families.
articles.title: Roseburg Library To Host Johnny Appleseed Puppet Show For Kids
